fields.statement: At 93f17e390 re-ran the Checks block: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide -run TestConduct, go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestGuideInstall, go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/guide, rhiza ship generate (0 changed) and rhiza render, all exit 0; full ./internal/guide also passes.
